mission: Read collected current technical state; report reproducible observed weaknesses and scoped review candidates with actionable remediation. Do not certify all business flows or overall security.
principles: An observed syntax or policy violation is not automatically an exploitable vulnerability.
No confirmed technical defect without a supported violated relationship or explicit applicable baseline.
Uncollected, malformed, unsupported or budget-truncated evidence cannot establish clean coverage.
A snapshot does not establish every checkout, authorization or business flow.
Preserve redaction, current quiet overview and separate structured scan diagnostics.
Keep existing wire and assessment cardinality compatible until a separately versioned additive migration is verified.

correlation.warning: Same file alone is never a sufficient deduplication key; different datasets/scopes are not automatically equivalent.
